Package com.radiantlogic.iddm.exceptions

package com.radiantlogic.iddm.exceptions
Exception classes for various IDDM SDK usage situations.

This package contains checked and unchecked exceptions that are thrown by the IDDM SDK framework when errors occur during plugin loading, configuration, operation execution, or other framework operations.

  • Exception Classes
    Class
    Description
    PluginConfigurationException
    Thrown when there is a problem with a plugin's metadata or configuration that prevents an operation.
    PluginException
    Base checked exception for IDDM plugin-related errors.
    PluginLoadingException
    Thrown when there is a fatal error during plugin loading or handling, not related to metadata validity.
    PluginLoadingRuntimeException
    Unchecked exception thrown when there is a fatal error during plugin loading or handling.
    PluginOperationNotSupportedException
    Unchecked exception thrown when a plugin/connector does not support the requested operation type.
    PluginRuntimeException
    Base unchecked exception for plugin/connector errors that are not recoverable.
